{{Quote|Gundarks! They're attacking the camp!|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=TheGundarksAreComing.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
Sometime between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]], on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], four predatory [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]] '''attacked''' a [[Attichitcuk's camp|camp]] built by the [[Wookiee Chieftain]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]]. Shortly before the attack, a large number of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] had arrived on Alaris Prime to [[Alaris Prime colonial war|settle]] there, and Attichitcuk, who was their leader, had begun [[Scout/Legends|exploring]] the moon and had set up the camp as their first base. Attichitcuk remained alone at the camp for a short [[Time/Legends|time]] until his [[Gender/Legends|nephew]] [[Shoran]] and son, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], fellow leaders of the colonists who were being guided by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], arrived to assist him. At the same time, the gundarks began their attack on the camp, forcing the three Wookiees to fight and [[Death/Legends|kill]] them. After the attack, the colonists explored Alaris Prime further and later successfully colonized it.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Looks like he's already staking a claim.|Qui-Gon Jinn, upon seeing Attichitcuk's camp|audio=AttichitcuksCamp.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Thalmussen_voyage.png|thumb|right|300px|The ''Thalmussen'' travels to Alaris Prime.]]
Sometime between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[59 BBY/Legends|59 BBY]] and [[56 BBY/Legends|56 BBY]],<ref name="NEC & GB">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Alaris Prime colonial war]] between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]], and the ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' databank states that the debate for [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime's]] colonial rights took place over a twenty-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] period following the [[Discovery of Alaris Prime|rediscovery]]. Therefore, using simple math, [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] was rediscovered between [[59 BBY/Legends|59 BBY]] and [[56 BBY/Legends|56 BBY]].</ref> [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Alaris/Legends|Alaris]], was [[Discovery of Alaris Prime|rediscovered]] by [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The Wookiees, represented by [[Wookiee Chieftain|Chieftan]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], petitioned the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to give them [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|colonization rights]] to the moon, and they were finally awarded them after twenty years of [[Politics/Legends|political]] debate. Attichitcuk was given leadership of the [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] in honor of his success in the Senate and, along with his [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]; nephew [[Shoran]]; and the rest of the colonists, headed for Alaris Prime aboard several [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]], including the ''[[Thalmussen]]''<ref name="GB" /> sometime between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].<ref name="NEC" /> The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] also sent [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], to assist the Wookiees by instructing them in various techniques useful for colonization.<ref name="GB" />

Upon landing on the moon, Attichitcuk began exploring while the other colonists remained in their [[Transport/Legends|transports]], leaving [[marker]]s so others could follow him and then constructing a [[Attichitcuk's camp|camp]]. Shoran later began [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] but halted when he encountered a [[Power core/Legends|power core]] built by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] corporation that had ignored the Senate's ruling and was beginning its own colonization effort on Alaris Prime. The power core had been damaged by [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]], a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] predatory species on Alaris Prime, preventing the Federation from developing that area further. Shoran waited until Chewbacca arrived, and, acting on advice from Jinn, the Wookiees destroyed the power core and followed Attichitcuk's markers until they reached him at his camp. Shortly after the two Wookiees arrived, four gundarks headed into the base to attack it.<ref name="GB" />

==The attack==
{{Quote|What's that? Attichitcuk smells trouble.|Qui-Gon Jinn, after Attichitcuk detected the gundarks|audio=AttichitcukSmells.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
Attichitcuk caught the scent of the gundarks and alerted the other Wookiees to their presence. Jinn also saw the approaching creatures but assured the colonists that the gundarks were no match for Wookiee warriors. Using their [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcasters]]&mdash;Wookiee projectile weapons&mdash;the three Wookiees fired at the attacking gundarks, [[Death/Legends|killing]] all of them and successfully defending the camp.<ref name="GB" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The gundarks must have damaged that power core and driven off its owners. We won't be so easily scared away.|Qui-Gon Jinn, after the attack|audio=GundarkPower.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:AttichitcuksCamp-SWGB.png|thumb|left|280px|Attichitcuk's camp was saved from the gundarks.]]
Immediately after the attack, Jinn speculated that the gundarks that the Wookiees had just defeated were the same ones that had damaged the power core they had encountered earlier. Later, the rest of the Wookiee colonists disembarked from the transports and began the process of colonizing Alaris Prime. After another Wookiee [[Unidentified Wookiee base (gundark attack)|base]] was [[Attack on the Wookiee command center|attacked]], the colonists decided to rid Alaris Prime of the gundarks and led an [[Skirmish at the gundark nest|attack]] on their [[Unidentified gundark nest|nest]], where the Wookiees discovered the Trade Federation's illegal presence on the moon. This led to a number of battles that culminated in the Wookiees [[Battle for Alaris Prime|defeating]] the Federation and claiming Alaris Prime as their own.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Click a warrior and right click a gundark to attack. Defeat them before they can tear down the camp!|Qui-Gon Jinn, instructing the player|audio=ClickAWarrior.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The attack on Attichitcuk's camp was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;before appearing in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The attack is part of the first level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, "Moving and Attacking," in which the player is taught how to attack opponents by using the Wookiees to defeat the gundarks. It is possible for the player to lose the level if either Attichitcuk, Chewbacca, or Shoran is killed,<ref name="GB" /> though the strategy guide states that this is an almost impossible outcome.<ref name="Prima" />
